[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=6]Repainting sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255?tab=posts]Seasonal Outfit Nyapu Style Retextures

[size=5]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt]AhCuteArt﻿[/url] and the author of the originals [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url],[/size]

[size=4]﻿and thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/mods?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url]﻿ for creating seasonal sprites in vanilla style.[/size][/font][/center]

[center]﻿[img]https://i.pinimg.com/736x/41/9f/c6/419fc63d30b96b94f26c42278f8c04f3.jpg[/img]﻿[/center]

[center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff0000][size=4]artist:[/size][/color][size=3] I do not know who drew this, but if you know, write[/size][/font][/center]

[color=#f1f1f1][font=Arial][size=5]I[/size][size=5][b]nstallation:

[/b][/size][/font][size=4][b]In short... In [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters Nyapu-style → assets, replace the Jac sprite and portrait files with my files.
[/b][/size]

[font=Arial][size=4]1. Download [i]all[/i] the necessary mods.[/size][/font]
[font=Arial][size=4]2. Download and open [b]my zip folder[/b]→ [b]assets[/b] → [b]Portraits and Characters[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Arial][size=4]3. Open [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters Nyapu-style[/b] → [b]assets [/b]→ [b]Portraits\Characters [/b]→ [b]Jas[/b], and replace the files from there with my files (in both cases)[/size][/font]
[font=Arial][size=4]4. Start the game and make sure that the crosses for Jas are marked in the mod settings for [b]Seasonal Cute Nyapu Portrait Retextures[/b] and [b]Seasonal Cute Characters[/b] (they are always enabled by default)[/size]

[size=5]If you have any difficulties, write to the Posts.[/size][/font]

[font=Arial][b][size=5]Установка:[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Если кратко -  в моде [/b][/size][/font][/color][font=Arial][size=4][color=#f1f1f1][b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters Nyapu-style [/b][b]→ assets [/b][/color]просто замените файлы спрайтов и портретов Джас моими файлами.[/size][/font][color=#f1f1f1]


[font=Arial][size=4]1. Скачайте  [i]в с е [/i] необходимые моды.[/size]
[/font][font=Arial][size=4]2. Загрузите и откройте мою zip-папку→ [b]assets[/b] → [b]Portraits and Characters.[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Arial][size=4]3. Откройте [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters Nyapu-style[/b]  → assets → [b]Portraits\Characters[/b] → [b]Jas[/b],  и замените файлы оттуда моими файлами (в обоих случаях).[/size]
[/font][font=Arial][size=4]4. Запустите игру и убедитесь, что в настройках модов [/size][b][size=4]Seasonal Cute Nyapu Portrait Retextures[/size][/b][size=4] и [/size][b][size=4]Seasonal Cute Characters[/size][/b][size=5] [/size][size=4]отмечены крестики для Джас (по умолчанию они всегда включены, но мало ли).[/size]

[/font][size=5]При возникновении сложностей пишите в Posts (Публикации).[/size]
